site.title: Site
parcel.title: Parcel
notice.parcelNotForSale: Protected land is not for sale.
map.align: Align view to ideal runway heading
hint.runway: Press and drag from one threshold to the other.
hint.runwayDrag: Release to build. Hold Alt for free angles.
hint.taxiway: Click to add points. Double click or Enter to finish, Backspace removes a point. Shift gives 15° steps, Alt is free.
hint.taxilane: Click to add points. Double click or Enter to finish.
hint.needRunway: Move the cursor near a runway.
hint.exit: Click to place the exit. The side follows the cursor.
hint.parallel: Click to build a parallel taxiway with connectors.
hint.apron: Click to add corners, double click or Enter to finish.
hint.stands: Click to place the row. R rotates 90°, Shift+R 15°.
hint.gaBlock: Click to place a GA apron with tie downs. R rotates.
hint.demolish: Click an object to demolish it. You get 25 percent of its cost back.

sites.title: Site
hint.terminal.foundation: Drag to lay a foundation. The first one starts a new building, R rotates it 90°. Build near the stands.
hint.terminal.floor: Drag over foundation to lay flooring.
hint.terminal.wall: Drag along a grid line to build a wall. Hold nothing, it snaps to the grid.
hint.terminal.door: Click a wall to put in a door, or a bare edge to open it.
hint.terminal.fixture: Drag over floor to place the chosen fixture in every free cell.
hint.terminal.erase: Drag to clear floor, fixtures and walls. Walls beside empty floor go too.
terminal.capacity: Departures {dep} per hour, arrivals {arr} per hour
inspector.terminalHint: Use the terminal tool to add or change anything.
notice.terminalBounds: That is outside the terminal's building area (320 m square).
notice.terminalTooLarge: That area is too large for one edit.
notice.terminalNeedsFoundation: There is no foundation there. Lay a foundation first.
notice.wallStraight: Walls run along a single grid line, horizontal or vertical.
